claims.exact_statement: For all fresh uniform physical selector blocks W of a bits and arbitrary Boolean branches g_b on one common uniform data cube, define R_T=E_b hat(g_b)(T)^2, r_T(b)=hat(g_b)(T)^2/(2^a R_T), nu_T(A)=hat(F)(A,T)^2/R_T, omitting R_T=0. Then Delta_W H=B_W+M_W, where B_W=sum_T R_T H(nu_T)=H(S_W|S_data), M_W=a-sum_T R_T H(r_T), and 0<=M_W<=(2/ln 2) I_W. M_W=0 iff all branch squared spectra coincide. Delta_W H=0 iff each nonzero coefficient row is a scalar Walsh character. For even m>=2 the bent/one-point-flip Boolean splice has I_W=2^{-m} and B_W>=2^{-m}(m-1), so a universal selector-only linear payment is false. These are source-complete reconstructions/characterizations, not a proof of full FEI.
hypotheses: All g_b Boolean on the same uniform finite data cube
Selector coordinates fresh from data and uniform independent
Entropy in bits; physical influence; zero-mass rows omitted
